author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 국내에서는 백두산의 고산 지대에서만 사는 새다. 이곳의 아종 usuriensis 는 우수리와 중국 동북 지방 등지에도 분포하며, 종 전체로는 북유럽과 북아시아 등지에 산다.

sexes.male: 온몸이 검고 머리·목·배에 푸른 광택이 있으며, 목둘레와 아래쪽 등, 허리에는 옅은 녹색 빛이 돈다. 날개에 흰 띠가 있고 아랫배와 넓적다리에는 회백색이 섞이며, 날개 아랫덮깃은 희다.
sexes.female: 배는 회색을 띤 암갈색이고 깃털마다 검은 가로무늬와 얼룩무늬가 있다. 몸길이는 수컷보다 작다.

art.subject: Black Grouse (Lyrurus tetrix), adult male: all black with a strong blue gloss on the head, neck and breast; a bare red comb swelling above the eye; a white spot at the bend of the closed wing and a narrow white wing bar; pure white undertail coverts; the long outer tail feathers curve outward to form a lyre shape. Short, stout black bill; dark eye; legs feathered greyish brown down to the toes.
art.pose: standing on the ground, side view
art.scene: Korean alpine zone high on Mount Baekdu, open high-mountain slopes; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view standing: glossy blue-black body, red comb above the eye, white spot at the bend of the wing and white wing bar, white undertail coverts, lyre-shaped tail with outward-curling outer feathers, black bill
adult female, side view standing: grey-brown to rufous-brown plumage closely barred and mottled black all over, including the belly, narrow white wing bar, slightly forked tail

adult male in flight, seen from below: white underwing coverts contrasting with the black body and dark flight feathers, white bar across the bases of the secondaries, white undertail, lyre-shaped tail
art.build: Large grouse; male about 54cm, female about 41cm and much smaller. Heavy, round-bodied gamebird with a small head, short thick neck and a short, stout, slightly downcurved bill much shorter than the head. Legs short and feathered. Wings short and rounded, held along the flanks at rest. Male tail long and lyre-shaped: at rest it is held closed behind the body, the long outer feathers curling outward at the tips, with the white undertail coverts showing beneath; female tail shorter and only slightly forked. Flight fast with whirring wingbeats and glides, showing a white wing bar and white underwing coverts.
avoid: Do not paint a fan-shaped turkey tail or a long pheasant tail; the male's outer tail feathers curl outwards into a lyre.
Do not give the female a crest or a black throat (Hazel Grouse, Tetrastes bonasia, which is much smaller).
Do not paint bare pink or yellow legs; the legs are feathered.
Do not draw the red skin as a wattle under the bill; it is a comb above the eye.
